subject: Coupa onboarding: PO routing, SSO mapping and signature authority (Order Form redline)
messages:
From: Sandra Lopez <sandra.lopez@medfolio.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medfolio.com, legal@medfolio.com
Date: Mon, 27 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Coupa onboarding: initial order form + PO routing question

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the quick onboarding help last week. Attached is the draft order form (v1) that our procurement team produced for the Coupa registration. A couple of items we need clarified before we finish vendor setup: 

1) PO routing / suffix: our ERP requires a PO suffix to map POs back to cost centers (we usually use company prefix MF-). Can Redwood confirm whether Coupa's PO integration will accept a suffix on the PO number or if we need a separate field?

2) Signature authority: our legal team flagged the MSA redline around signature delegation (section 4.1). If Redwood needs business-level sign-off instead of legal, can you confirm who will sign the order form and what the signature matrix looks like for recurring monthly invoices?

3) Indemnity redline: we included a minimal indemnity change in the proposed redline doc — we wanted to know whether Redwood can accept the language or prefers negotiation.

We'd love to lock these items today so we can finish Coupa registration this week. I can jump on a 30-minute call if helpful.

Attachments: medfolio_orderform_v1.pdf; medfolio_proposed_msaredline_v1.docx

Thanks,
Sandra Lopez
Sr. Procurement Manager | Medfolio
On behalf of Medfolio Procurement

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sandra Lopez <sandra.lopez@medfolio.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 27 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Coupa onboarding: initial order form + PO routing question

Sandra —

Appreciate the doc drops. Quick read-through and proposed plan below so we can close this week.

Summary of action items (proposed):
- PO routing: engineering confirms Coupa mapping will support a PO suffix (prefixing with MF- is fine). We recommend using the PO "referenceId" field for suffix mapping to preserve canonical PO numbers; ops can map that into your ERP during ingestion.
- Signature authority: legal prefers 1) order form signed by Redwood's VP of Revenue for standard monthly subscriptions, or 2) delegated signer (Director level) for deals under $75k ARR. I'll loop in Kim (legal ops) to finalize the matrix.
- Indemnity redline: initial legal read suggests the proposed language is acceptable with one edit (narrow the third-party carve-out). Kim will propose the exact wording in a follow-up.

Next steps I propose:
1) Quick sync (30 min) today at 2pm PT to confirm the PO mapping field and signature matrix.
2) Kim to send a tracked-change redline of the MSA and a one-paragraph justification for the indemnity edit.
3) Mateo to share a short Coupa mapping template so your procurement team can populate test values for the SSO and PO suffix.

I attached our internal signature matrix template (redwood_signature_matrix.csv) for your convenience — fill in the signatory names you expect and we'll confirm delegation.

If that timeline works, I'll send the calendar invite.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Subject: RE: Coupa onboarding: initial order form + PO routing question

Hi all —

Thanks for the meeting this morning — good alignment. Following up with the legal takeaways and the concrete text we propose for the MSA indemnity and signature delegation.

1) Signature delegation (order form)
- Proposed language to add to order form: "For recurring subscription orders up to $75,000 ARR, the parties agree that signatory authority may be delegated to a Director-level officer as listed in the attached signature matrix."
- Delegation exceptions: any multi-year commitment or custom work requires VP-level sign-off.

2) Indemnity redline
- Proposed edited sentence (tracked): "Each party shall indemnify the other against third-party claims arising solely from the indemnifying party's gross negligence or willful misconduct, excluding claims arising from the receiving party's misuse of the services."
- Rationale: narrows the indemnity carve-out and keeps the clause reciprocal.

3) PO suffix / Coupa mapping
- Confirmation: Redwood will accept MF- prefix in the PO reference field. If Medfolio's ERP requires the suffix appended to the canonical PO id, Ops can accept either but prefer the referenceId approach to keep canonical numbering stable.

I've attached the updated tracked redline (medfolio_proposed_msaredline_v1.docx) with comments and our signature_matrix.csv template for immediate completion. Please populate the matrix with names and titles; procurement can own the completed matrix and return to us.

Attachments: medfolio_proposed_msaredline_v1.docx (with comments); redwood_signature_matrix.csv

Kimberly Park
Legal Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
